MANAGE Sindhudurg and Latur annual-income figures are total farmer income, not bamboo-only income. The report says bamboo-based income could not be recorded for Latur because many plantations were newly established.
Palakkad per-truck costs are from 1994–95 and are historical only. The 2026 Karnataka paper reports transport at 25–40% of expenses, but the cost base needs checking; it is not a freight tariff.

Labour Bureau occupational wage rates are benchmarks, not necessarily bamboo-only earnings. In Jan 2025–26, Karnataka bamboo/cane basket-weaver wage is unavailable (@ / dash); do not carry forward the earlier figure.
The 2026 Frontiers paper reports 128 respondents across eight Karnataka districts. Its product-price table has ambiguous year labels, so product prices were deliberately excluded.
Missing information is not filled with estimates. Add field interviews only after recording date, location, unit, respondent role and consent.
